The sim HAS the correct helper and the correct stream: `get_distinct_for_combat_parity(rng, count, ...)` (cards/pool.py:182-204) reproduces UnstableShuffle-then-take over the CombatCardGeneration accessor, and `CombatRng.card_gen` is that accessor (combat_rng.py:20, 50). This is PROMPT.md bug class 16's second half -- a named C# stream reaching a sim helper that silently falls back to the shared RNG -- and class 12's 'check whether a sibling already does the thing': relics/vexing_puzzlebox.py:29-33 is a ported RARE relic that generates ONE pool card at turn start and branches `if crng.is_parity: get_distinct_for_combat_parity(crng.card_gen, 1) else: random_pool_cards(self.combat._rng, 1)`. EXECUTED (`py tools/audit/relic_probes_b16.py toolbox-stream`): toolbox's source contains no 'is_parity' and no 'card_gen'; vexing_puzzlebox's contains both. Seven further ported sites use the parity helper (cards/infernal_blade.py:41, cards/mad_science.py:152, potions.py:453/482/1101/1134/1167), so this is a one-site omission, not a house convention. Rule 7: cards/pool.py, combat_rng.py, relics/vexing_puzzlebox.py and audits/relic/astrolabe.json are NOT hashed by this record.
